rules.text: No collection notices while the counterparty is in bankruptcy.
No past-due notice while the counterparty's own money, waiting to be applied, covers everything it has past due.
No late fee while the counterparty's own money, waiting to be applied, covers everything it has past due.
No fee is charged to a counterparty in bankruptcy (the automatic stay).
The collections seat sends notices and assesses contractual fees.

learned.text: No vendor payment is released while a bank-account change is pending and has not been confirmed out of band.
No debit is initiated while a bank-account change is pending and has not been confirmed out of band.
No refund is released while a bank-account change is pending and has not been confirmed out of band.
